mapIdentity.scope: Official monument polygon 895 and the named OSM valve-house rectangle agree to local surveying tolerance. The surveyed shore and separate dam scene set the base.

note: Rectangular rusticated granite house with flat moulded coping, arched openings, blocked road-facing windows and projecting metal catwalks over the reservoir-side face.
